item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I did not find a single Trọng-authored 2024 master plan with line-item budgets and deadlines spanning the whole agenda. The evidence is dispersed across government resolutions, sector implementation plans, audit rules, and Reuters reporting on appointments and reshuffles.","evidence":[{"title":"Major tasks and solutions to implement 2024 socio-economic development plan","publisher":"Government of Viet Nam","date":"2024-01-08","url":"https://en.baochinhphu.vn/major-tasks-and-solutions-to-implement-2024-socio-economic-development-plan-111240108212720274.htm","summary":"The government set 2024 priorities around macroeconomic stability, inflation control, active monetary and fiscal policy, and legislative/institutional reform tied to the state budget. This is direct evidence of a governing program being turned into concrete priorities and policy sequencing.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Plan for implementing the Social Insurance Law 2024","publisher":"Viet Nam Social Security","date":"2024-11-26","url":"https://vss.gov.vn/english/news/Pages/vietnam-social-security.aspx?CateID=198&ItemID=12375","summary":"The social security sector created a steering group, assigned agency responsibilities, set a national roadmap, and ordered inspection, guidance, and problem-solving for implementation. This is strong evidence of translation into timelines, institutions, and enforcement mechanisms.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10"]},{"title":"Audit standards of the State Audit Office of Viet Nam 2024","publisher":"State Audit Office of Viet Nam","date":"2024","url":"https://sav.gov.vn/en/Pages/detail.aspx?ItemID=261&l=News","summary":"The audit office issued 43 standards covering financial, compliance, and performance audits, with explicit emphasis on professionalism, honesty, objectivity, openness, and public trust. This is concrete institutionalization, not just rhetoric.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10"]},{"title":"Audit oversight and enforcement resolution","publisher":"Chính phủ Việt Nam / National Assembly mirror","date":"2024-07-16","url":"https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/nghi-quyet-so-141-2024-qh15-ve-hoat-dong-chat-van-tai-ky-hop-thu-7-quoc-hoi-khoa-xv-119240716155719243.htm","summary":"The resolution calls for revising audit law and procedures, focusing audits on sensitive issues, publicizing audit results, tracking compliance, and disciplining weak or improper audit work. That is a clear enforcement architecture, not a vague commitment.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10"]},{"title":"Vietnam names acting president after legislature votes to remove Thuong","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-03-21","url":"https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-names-acting-president-after-legislature-votes-to-remove-thuong/2009559/","summary":"The leadership removed a top official amid the anti-graft campaign and appointed an acting president through formal constitutional procedure. This shows Trọng’s program being converted into personnel control and disciplinary enforcement.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10","8B.1"]},{"title":"Vietnam Communist Party names police minister as state president / To Lam takes top job","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint / ReutersFeed","date":"2024-05-18 and 2024-08-03","url":"https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-communist-party-names-police-minister-as-state-president/2091207/ and https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-president-to-lam-takes-top-job-as-communist-party-chief/2205833/","summary":"The anti-graft drive produced further leadership turnover, with To Lam elevated first to president and then to party chief. This is concrete appointment-based enforcement, but it also shows the program ran through elite reshuffling rather than stable institutionalization alone.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10","8B.1"]},{"title":"Vietnam minister says president's resignation has not affected policies","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-03-26","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/vietnam-hopes-us-will-soon-recognize-its-market-economy-status-fm-son-says-3353681","summary":"The foreign minister said policy continuity rested on collective leadership, not one individual, and that the anti-corruption drive was consistent with existing policy. This is moderate evidence of an explicit governing model, though it is institutional rather than personally Trọng-authored.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Vietnam's anti-graft campaign caused administrative paralysis","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint / Reuters via MarketScreener","date":"2024-05-17 and 2024-05-20","url":"https://theprint.in/world/exclusive-vietnam-forfeits-billions-of-dollars-in-foreign-aid-amid-anti-graft-freeze-document-says/2088974/ and https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-removes-third-top-leader-in-two-months-reshuffles-cadres/2092648/","summary":"Reuters reported delayed approvals, lost aid, upheaval, infighting, and a chilling effect on bureaucracy. This is the strongest counterevidence: the program was real, but its translation into administration was politically disruptive and often brittle.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Trọng’s duties were transferred on July 18 because of illness","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint / Government of Viet Nam","date":"2024-07-18 to 2024-07-19","url":"https://en.baochinhphu.vn/politburo-issues-notice-on-party-general-secretarys-health-111240718161208612.htm and https://theprint.in/world/vietnams-top-leader-trong-dies-at-80-party-says/2181868/","summary":"By mid-July, effective day-to-day control had already shifted away from Trọng. That limits how confidently late-2024 implementation can be attributed to him personally, even if the institutional program continued.","question_ids":["8B.2"]}]}
